leftHand = \fixed c {

  bes,4 <f' bes d>4 | f,4 <c' f a>4 |

crossHand = \relative c'' {

  \time 2/4
  \voiceTwo
  s2 | s2 | s2 | s2 | s2 | s2 | s2 | s2 |
